objects.name: calib
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE calib (
	calib_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"scanNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	job_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	filefolder VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"filenamePrefix" JSON NOT NULL, 
	author VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	calib_config VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	cenx FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	dist FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	anglez FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	angley FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	anglex FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	cenz FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	shift_parameter FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (calib_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("scanNumber") REFERENCES metadata ("scanNumber"), 
	UNIQUE (job_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES job (job_id)
)

objects.name: catalog
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE catalog (
	catalog_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"scanNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	filefolder VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"filenamePrefix" JSON NOT NULL, 
	aperture VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sample_name VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (catalog_id), 
	UNIQUE ("scanNumber"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("scanNumber") REFERENCES metadata ("scanNumber")
)

objects.name: indexing_run
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE indexing_run (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scan_number INTEGER, 
	reconstruction_id INTEGER, 
	job_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	output_path VARCHAR, 
	author VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	algorithm_version VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	n_frames_indexed INTEGER, 
	results_path VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_indexing_run_method CHECK (method IN ('lauego', 'laue_matching')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_number) REFERENCES metadata ("scanNumber"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reconstruction_id) REFERENCES reconstruction_run (id), 
	UNIQUE (job_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES job (job_id)
)

objects.name: job
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE job (
	job_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	computer_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	submit_time DATETIME, 
	start_time DATETIME, 
	finish_time DATETIME, 
	messages VARCHAR, 
	phase VARCHAR, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	heartbeat_at DATETIME, 
	cancel_requested_at DATETIME, 
	queue_job_id VARCHAR, 
	n_inputs INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	n_succeeded INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	n_failed INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	n_not_run INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	run_directory VARCHAR, 
	manifest_path VARCHAR, 
	manifest_digest VARCHAR, 
	request_path VARCHAR, 
	failure_report_path VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (job_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_counters_non_negative CHECK (n_inputs >= 0 AND n_succeeded >= 0 AND n_failed >= 0 AND n_not_run >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_counters_bounded CHECK (n_succeeded + n_failed + n_not_run <= n_inputs)
)

	detector_crop_x1 INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	detector_crop_x2 INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	detector_crop_y1 INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	detector_crop_y2 INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	min_size FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	max_peaks INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	smooth BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	mask_file VARCHAR, 
	index_kev_max_calc FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	index_kev_max_test FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	index_angle_tolerance FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	index_h INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	index_k INTEGER NOT NULL,

objects.name: reconstruction_run
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE reconstruction_run (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scan_number INTEGER, 
	job_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	output_path VARCHAR, 
	author VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	algorithm_version VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reconstruction_run_method CHECK (method IN ('wire', 'ca')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_number) REFERENCES metadata ("scanNumber"), 
	UNIQUE (job_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES job (job_id)
)
